og_title: A Mortal’s Heavy Price for a Home in the Sky
og_description: Chapter 397: Han Li learns the brutal economics of Heaven Star City—2,700 stones for a century on the 39th layer, then layers of formations and a jade beetle room.
twitter_title: 2,700 spirit stones for a cave? Han Li crunches the numbers.
twitter_description: Han Li settles into a new cave dwelling in Heaven Star City, paying a fortune for premium qi—then immediately reinforcing security and setting up a jade chamber for his beetles.

lore_anchors.definition: The central spiritual mountain of Heaven Star City, divided into 81 layers; the higher the layer, the richer the qi.
The capital of the Starfall Sea, built around the Sacred Mountain and controlled by the Star Palace.
A natural concentration of spiritual qi in the earth, essential for efficient cultivation; higher-quality veins accelerate cultivation speed.
The supreme governing authority of the Starfall Sea, controlling Heaven Star City and the Sacred Mountain.
A private, fortified cultivation residence carved into a mountain or underground, typically with built-in formations and a spirit garden.
The third major cultivation realm after Qi Condensation and Foundation Establishment; grants greatly increased power and lifespan.
Rare, highly ranked insect beasts that consume metal and are prized for their potential as a combat tool; requires specialized care.
A speed-focused flying artifact used by Han Li for long-distance travel.

cultural_notes_faq.q: What is the Sacred Mountain’s spirit vein?
cultural_notes_faq.a: It is one of the top five in the Starfall Sea, allowing cultivation speed to increase by more than a quarter on layers above the 30th; the higher the layer, the denser the qi.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why did Han Li pay 2,700 spirit stones for a cave dwelling?
cultural_notes_faq.a: The fee covers a full century of access to a premium qi environment on the 39th layer, which accelerates cultivation speed significantly—a long-term investment in efficiency.

cultural_notes_faq.q: What are the Gold Devourer Beetles?
cultural_notes_faq.a: They are rare, highly ranked insect beasts that consume metal and can be trained into powerful combat assets; Han Li places them in a jade-lined chamber to optimize their development.
